layout.body:
SPACE FOR LIVING
ASK A DESIGNER AT HOME DÉCOR EVENT
Come and talk to HOME DÉCOR’s design consultants. They’ll answer your questions about interior designing and give you tips on how to create beautiful rooms you will love. Brought to you by Space For Living, HOME DÉCOR’s Design Series. Join us for this exciting event, and receive a special gift. Tickets are available at your local HOME DÉCOR store. For further details, visit HOMEDECOR.com.

questions.stem: Who would most likely be interested in attending the event?

options.A: Students who are studying to become designers
options.B: Homemakers who want to improve the ambience of their homes
options.C: Employees of HOME DÉCOR who want some consultations
options.D: Shoppers who are looking to save some money

questions.analysis: Who would most likely be interested in attending the event? 原文依据：answer your questions about interior designing and give you tips on how to create beautiful rooms you will love 活动内容是室内设计咨询、打造漂亮的房间，所以最感兴趣的是想改善家里环境的人。 A：想学设计的学生 → 不是主要目标人群 B：想改善家居氛围的家庭主妇 / 主夫 → 正确 C：HOME DÉCOR 员工 → 错，活动是给顾客的 D：想省钱的购物者 → 错，活动重点不是省钱

questions.stem: How can one receive admittance to the event?

options.D: By getting permission from a design consultant

questions.analysis: How can one receive admittance to the event? 原文依据：Tickets are available at your local HOME DÉCOR store. 入场需要门票，可以在门店领取。 A：领取门票 → 正确 B：写信给商店 → 文中没提 C：购买商品 → 文中没说要买东西 D：获得设计师许可 → 错
